## COOLING

### Axial-tech Upgrades

#### A Fresh Spin

Three tried-and-true Axial-tech fans feature a smaller hub that facilitates longer blades and a barrier ring to increase downward air pressure for lower temperatures, less noise, and higher performance

### 0dB Technology

#### Quiet Intelligence

All three fans come to a standstill when GPU temps are below 50 Celsius, letting you play less demanding games or perform light tasks in relative silence. Fans start up again when temperatures are over 55°C, establishing a speed curve that balances performance and acoustics for work or play.

### Dual Ball Fan Bearings

#### 2x longer lifespan

Different bearing types have unique pros and cons. Ball bearings excel at durability and can last up to twice as long as sleeve bearing designs.

### 2.5-slot Design

#### Sink your heat into this 

A carefully designed layout for the shroud, heatsink and heatpipe lets the three Axial-tech fans leverage chassis side-panel ventilation and deliver thermal performance normally associated with larger cooling systems.

...

### Auto−Extreme Technology

#### Reliability Boost

Auto-Extreme Technology is an automated manufacturing process that sets new standards in the industry by allowing all soldering to be completed in a single pass. This reduces thermal strain on components and avoids the use of harsh cleaning chemicals, resulting in less environmental impact, lower manufacturing power consumption and a more reliable product overall.

### Protective Backplate 

The PCB is reinforced by a backplate that adds structural rigidity, helping to prevent flex and protect components and trace pathways from damage. The rear features a wide vent that allows hot air to escape towards chassis fans instead of being recycled back into the GPU cooler.

### Dual BIOS

#### Choose wisely

Do you prioritize low core temps or low noise levels? Performance mode will let the fans spin up to keep the card running cool all the time. Quiet mode keeps the same power target and top-end settings, but it offers a less aggressive fan curve for quieter operation at medium temps. For even more customization and control, check out our GPU Tweak III software.

## EXPERIENCE

- ### 144-hour Validation Program 

#### “Extensive” may be an understatement 

A 144-hour validation program puts cards through a series of stringent tests to ensure compatibility with the latest games.
- ### Stainless Steel Bracket

#### Steel yourself

The mounting bracket for the PRIME GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER features grade 304 stainless steel, chosen for its strength and high resistance to corrosion.

Title: ASUS PRIME RTX 4070 Ti SUPER unveiled: SFF-Ready ...
URL: https://videocardz.com/newz/asus-prime-rtx-4070-ti-super-unveiled-sff-ready-and-ad102-gpu
Published: 2024-09-18T13:26:16.000Z
Author: WhyCry
Highlights:
The PRIME new series is specifically designed to meet NVIDIA’s new SFF-Ready program. 

We are not going to debate whether NVIDIA SFF-Ready makes any sense. The ASUS PRIME series is a ‘prime’ example of why these cards could hardly be considered Small Form Factor compatible—there is nothing small about them. Yet, this is what NVIDIA came up with.

The new PRIME cards are both based on the GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, equipped with 8,448 CUDA cores and 16GB of GDDR6X memory. ASUS hasn’t confirmed which version of the 4070 Ti SUPER this is, but it’s relatively easy to tell by looking at the backside. The capacitor layout is exclusive to the AD102 GPU, not the AD103, which the original model uses.

...

The dimensions of the PRIME models match NVIDIA’s SFF guidelines, which are 300 x 120 x 50 mm (2.5-slot). They also use a single 16-pin power connector. Two models were announced, either featuring factory overclocking at 2,625 MHz or the NVIDIA reference frequency of 2,610 MHz. As always, ASUS provides custom OC settings, which can be applied manually through the GPU Tweak 3 software. If overclocked, gamers can expect frequencies of 2,655 MHz or 2,640 MHz, respectively.
